fair_value.qualification: relative-value candidate, not guaranteed arbitrage; no creation/redemption access

order_flow.data_source: seeded synthetic events generated locally; no market validation
order_flow.split_policy: chronological 60/20/20; raw windows disjoint; train-only scaler; validation-only epoch selection

selection.criterion: lowest validation standardized MAE, including persistence

order_flow.arima_specification: ARIMA(1,1,0) with drift, conditional OLS on train only; LSTM forecasts residual correction
limitations: Synthetic data only; no evidence of tradable edge.
Forecast errors do not imply profitability; costs and fills require separate simulation.
No historical crisis calibration, six-month historical test, or elapsed paper trading.

summary.sharpe_note: Intraday toy sample: no credible annualised Sharpe
summary.note: Open positions marked to market; no realised-return claim

mean_reversion.note: Descriptive fit only; not a stationarity or profitability test

95.note: Fewer than 20 expected tail observations is unstable; ties do not add tail resolution.

99.note: Fewer than 20 expected tail observations is unstable; ties do not add tail resolution.

99.9.note: Fewer than 20 expected tail observations is unstable; ties do not add tail resolution.

risk.horizon: one synthetic second; no time scaling
risk.method: Empirical nearest-rank loss quantile; ES averages losses >= quantile

stress.methodology: Hypothetical event-inspired scenarios, NOT historical replay; both directions; full forced liquidation
stress.limitation: Linear depth-impact toy model; basket tracking, borrow and market closure risk are not fully modelled

validation_evidence.benchmark: No-edge cash baseline for engineering; real ETF total-return benchmark pending
validation_evidence.sharpe_convention: Not estimated: short intraday synthetic sample
validation_evidence.fx_assumption: USD desk; illustrative capacity scenarios denominated directly in GBP

reasons: Synthetic or unidentified data supports engineering only
